summary: Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq under RIBB/RIBBU/RIBBR, filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, announcing that its Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders has been rescheduled from September 14, 2026 to November 14, 2026, both at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Only holders of record as of February 18, 2026 may vote; previously submitted proxies remain valid unless revoked, and no shareholder action is required. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. The adjournment extends the clock on the pending SPAC vote; watch for redemption levels and any charter-extension mechanics.
